hooks.name: V2.0 World Refine Loop
hooks.description: Automatically identifies and fixes the top visual defect in the latest V2.0 world on each session start — iteratively refining placement, decimation, lighting, and camera until the 3D world closely matches the Canon photo.

action.prompt:
You are continuing the V2.0 world refinement loop. On each session:

1. Find the latest completed V2.0 session in output/ (has scene.json + mesh_manifest.json).
2. Identify the top visual defect from this priority list:
   a. Objects piled at origin (0,0,0) → fix placement using catalog bboxes + depth map
   b. Meshes too dense for browser (>30K faces) → run server-side decimation
   c. Missing textures or materials → check GLB integrity
   d. Lighting too dark or flat → improve scene.json lighting from Canon analysis
   e. Camera spawn wrong → adjust spawn to match Canon viewpoint
3. Apply ONE fix (the highest-priority one not yet done).
4. Rebuild scene.json if placements changed.
5. Verify the fix by checking the scene manifest serves correctly.
6. Commit the code change (not the output/ artifacts).
7. Log what was fixed and what the next priority defect is.
8. Provide the restore URL: http://127.0.0.1:8000/?v=2.0&session={id}

Key files:
- src/unified_pipeline/v2_mesh_builder.py (mesh generation + placement)
- src/unified_pipeline/v2_assembler.py (scene.json assembly)
- src/web/static/v2_0.js (Three.js renderer)
- output/{session_id}/artifacts/scene.json (live scene manifest)
- output/{session_id}/artifacts/mesh_manifest.json (mesh inventory)
- output/{session_id}/artifacts/catalog.json (object catalog with bboxes)

Session to refine: check output/ for the most recent directory with artifacts/scene.json.
Current known defects: objects at (0,0,0), no server-side decimation applied to existing meshes.
